newsitem.title: UK: HALIFAX STILL REVIEWING MORTGAGE RATES.
newsitem.headline: HALIFAX STILL REVIEWING MORTGAGE RATES.

text.p: Britain's largest mortgage lender the Halifax Plc said on Friday it was unlikely to adjust its mortgage rates today but it was still reviewing its position.
"We are probably not going to move today, but we are still reviewing our position," said Halifax press officer Alison Kellington.
The Bank of England decided on Thursday to raise interest by a quarter point to 7.0 percent, forcing some home lenders to follow suit.
Earlier, Britain's Abbey National Plc announced it was increasing its standard variable rates by 25 basis points with effect from August 11 for new customers.
The Halifax currently offers standard variable rate mortgages at 8.2 percent. The home lender last adjusted its variable rate on July 17 to 8.2 percent from 7.95 percent.
